0.0: I'm #b#p2020000##k, the best blacksmith around. If I can't make the thing you want, nobody else can! So, do you want anything?

0.2: You have to gather all the components for the hammer. And I'll make it for you. If we work together, we can conquer the rock! Are you ready?

1.0: Excellent! I can make it now. I have made hundreds of hammers. The most important things are the base components!

yes.0: I don't know why you want to break the ancient ice stone. Good luck! I made the best Orihalcon hammer for you. Are you going to see the Ancient Ice Stone now?
